section: ER-02 Site conditions and design data
text: Equipment shall operate at full capability between -8 degC and +40 degC dry bulb and 18 % to 100 % relative humidity, and survive -15 degC to +45 degC. Climatic data per ALP-OWN-MET-001 (10-year site record; extremes -11.4 degC / +39.6 degC).
title: Ambient design range
